comment: The curated suggested-model list shown in Model management before searching. format 'ggml'/'gguf' entries are single files runnable by the whisper.cpp engine (Metal-accelerated on Apple Silicon), downloaded from https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/main/<file>. format 'mlx' entries are whole-repo directory models (config.json + safetensors) run by the MLX engine via the mlx-audio CLI; the entire repo is downloaded into <models>/<repo-basename>/. MLX entries need Apple Silicon and are greyed out elsewhere.

models.name: whisper-large-v3
models.note: GGML build of whisper-large-v3 — runs on Metal GPU

models.name: tinydiarize-small.en (tdrz)
models.note: whisper small.en with speaker-turn tokens — the TinyDiarize diarization strategy

models.name: parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3
models.note: NVIDIA Parakeet · 25 languages · fast · runs via mlx-audio
